decision.name: STATIC_AUDIT_POINTER_IS_NOT_GENERATION_PROOF
decision.finding: Exact handoff.py build_anata_handoff returns audit_artifact='audit_latest.json' (unversioned basename); runner.py independently replaces latest.json, audit_latest.json and anata_latest.json. Thus equal as_of_ms across files can pass despite mixed same-clock content, and handoff's static audit pointer cannot prove that its referenced audit belongs to the same publication. This is a concrete source-level integrity gap, not a witnessed reader defect. P0 writer-final agreement, reader snapshot, and P1 archive admission must remain separate gates.
improved_no_network_acceptance: At exact public SHA, baseline python -m pytest -q part2/capital_flow/tests -rs; capture exit code/stdout/stderr.

Use pinned P0 test-only two-writer overlay with two distinct as_of_ms values and B-overlap witness; require all three final files share as_of_ms, non-skips and no errors. A no-overlap PASS without proven lock is INCONCLUSIVE.

Add test-only same-clock G0/G1 offline fixtures with distinct deterministic payloads (not just timestamps). Interleave consumer read and writer publication; require a documented consumer-facing generation identifier/digest/manifest linking handoff and audit, or fail-closed/retry. A stamp-only equality check is NOT reader GREEN; without consumer protocol, INTERFACE_BLOCKED.
Use pinned POSIX P1 same/distinct-ID process admission overlay; require actual B_READ_BEFORE_A_RELEASE witness for race reproduction, or explicit lock proof; otherwise INCONCLUSIVE.

Run targeted python -m pytest -q -s -rs part2/capital_flow/tests/test_runner_output_generation.py part2/capital_flow/tests/test_archive_process_matrix.py and full python -m pytest -q part2/capital_flow/tests -rs after test-only overlay; retain hashes, exit codes, logs and witnesses.
